instructions.primary_message: Place beef and spices in a medium bowl and mix with your hands until well combined. Working with 2 tablespoons of meat at a time, form the beef mixture into ½-inch thick "nuggets" and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g lean ground beef
1 tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place cornstarch in another medium bowl. Working one at a time, add beef nuggets to the bowl with the cornstarch and turn to coat. Return to the plate.

Spray air fryer basket with cooking spray. Working in batches to best fit the size of your air fryer, add nuggets to the basket, spacing them at least ½-inch apart. Coat beef with additional cooking spray.
Insert basket into the air fryer and set temperature to 400°F. Cook, flipping halfway, until nuggets are golden and cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove basket from air fryer.
Serve nuggets with ketchup for dipping and enjoy!
